scene: Through the neon moon gate, a bustling transit concourse fans out before you.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of a wide transit plaza. Far left, a wooden solar-sail junk rocks gently at a canal dock. Left, the player stands on roller skates by a glowing ticket kiosk. Up high centre, a round cable pod waits at a lift gate. Far right, a sleek pink bullet train rests along a platform.
shown: a docked wooden junk with glowing solar sails moored on the far left
a glass spherical cable pod hovering open at a platform up high
a sleek pink bullet train with open sliding doors on the far right
